title: VPN backlog batch: DMVPN/OpenConnect/PPTP/SSTP/Overview
acceptance_criteria: Backend routers exist for openconnect, pptp, sstp, dmvpn, and vpn overview while preserving existing API contracts.
Form-driven VPN pages exist for /vpn, /vpn/dmvpn, /vpn/openconnect, /vpn/pptp, and /vpn/sstp with no free-form command text areas.
VPN sidebar includes links for all new pages.
Backend tests, frontend typecheck/build, runtime smoke, and browser smoke pass on localhost.
Coverage artifacts regenerate with VPN domain moving to fully implemented status.
assumptions: DMVPN implementation focuses on tunnel/NHRP/IPsec-profile workflows documented in VyOS docs and does not attempt to replace full IPsec policy editing.
Unrelated pre-existing dirty files in the worktree remain untouched.
OpenConnect/PPTP/SSTP pages prioritize common deployment paths first and can be expanded with more advanced RADIUS/PPP branches in follow-up slices.

tasks.notes: Added scoped backend routers for the remaining VPN backlog pages.
Implemented form-first VPN pages and navigation updates.
Extended backend scope tests and smoke route coverage for the new VPN pages.
Regenerated parity matrix/backlog after VPN batch completion.
Manual review completed; command scope guards and API contract compatibility confirmed.
